New: an optional glass look for the open notch, and a click on a notification no longer opens Setup.

What's new

- Glass (Setup → Effects, off unless turned on): the open notch becomes frosted glass and the desktop behind it shows through, blurred. On macOS 26 and later it is Liquid Glass, tinted towards your theme so small text stays readable over any wallpaper; on earlier versions it is the blur menus use. Rows, panels and cards turn into thin see-through fills on the glass, and the hover cards and the Prod banner stay nearly opaque so the rows under them do not show through. The strip on the notch stays black, and the closed notch looks as it always did. Reduce Transparency keeps the solid look; Increase Contrast strengthens it.

Fixes

- A click on a notification sometimes opened the Setup window as well as what the notification should do. A click now never opens Setup; opening AI Notch yourself from Finder, Spotlight or `open` still does. Each notification click and each reopen is noted in `~/.claude/notch/notch.log`, so if Setup ever still opens from a click, the log shows why.

Install or upgrade:

    brew install --cask ankeshshankar/tap/ai-notch
    brew upgrade --cask ai-notch

First open: the app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so macOS blocks it once. Open AI Notch, then in System Settings → Privacy & Security click Open Anyway and confirm with your password. If Set Up then reports the helper is blocked, run the command it shows:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AINotch.app

Requires macOS 15 or later.
